continuation_convention: The starting rate continues after its fixed period unless a renewal scenario is adopted. A supplied quote covers its LTV band across repayment terms and calibrates estimates for other bands.
assumptions: Synthetic household. Constant house price, zero cash interest, no inflation or tax. Opening investments use unrestricted savings left after deposit, reserve, costs and upfront fee. Annual overpayment allowance is 10% of the opening balance each mortgage year for assumed rates. Unknown quoted allowances redirect surplus to cash during the fix.
